RESEARCH
Summer research assistant, Arabic language technology lab of a research university on the Red Sea coast
June 2026 - August 2026
- Prepared 180,000 Arabic customer-complaint tweets for training: stripped diacritics and letter elongation, dropped duplicate retweets, and split the text into sub-word pieces.
- Labelled 3,000 of them by dialect with two other assistants and measured how often we agreed.
- Adapted a pretrained Arabic transformer encoder to sort complaints into nine topics. Macro-F1 rose from 0.71 for a bag-of-words baseline to 0.86.
- Ran every experiment on the lab's shared GPU machine over SSH and kept each run's settings and scores in a spreadsheet so that results could be repeated.
- Presented the results at the lab's end-of-summer meeting; my supervisor is including them in a workshop paper.

COMPETITIONS
- Two bronze medals in online tabular-data competitions (top 9% and top 8% of about 2,000 teams). My best entry blended gradient-boosted trees, used features I built from dates and locations, and was checked with five-fold validation before every submission.
- Jazan AI Challenge 2025, 2nd place: trained a model that counts mango fruit in tree photos taken from a drone, for a local farm cooperative.
